name: Songbirds' Blessing
oracle_text:
Enchant creature
Whenever enchanted creature attacks, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal an Aura card. You may put that card onto the battlefield. If you don't, put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
blocked_sentences: Whenever enchanted creature attacks, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal an Aura card. You may put that card onto the battlefield. If you don't, put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

needs.what: a per-card yes/no on reveal_until's match -- 'you may put that card onto the battlefield; if you don't, put it into your hand' -- e.g. a `may_destination: "battlefield"` with `destination: "hand"` as the fallback, asked of the controller while the match is still in the library and before the rest is bottomed. The Aura's host is already chosen as it enters (303.4f, zones.offer_aura_host)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: reveal_until makes no yes/no decision (destination and destination_if are fixed, selector-driven), and reveal_until to hand followed by `may put_onto_battlefield` moves the card from the hand rather than the library -- a second zone change, through a hand -- and bottoms the rest before the choice
